objective: Ten distinct three-dragon PvP-oriented formations balancing damage, troop survival, active habit interactions, positional effects and positive troop affinity; prioritize five for deployment.

methodology.optimization_type: mechanics-guided qualitative allocation, not numerical global optimum or simulator result
constraints: no repeated dragons among ten marches
all three dragons have positive affinity for assigned troop type
do not count locked star-gated effects as active
methodology.season_context: September 17–23 Kingswood Hunt White Stag encounters use Physical damage and Stagger; this is a PvE-specific matchup note, not evidence of a season-wide PvP meta.
methodology.warning: No current-season-wide verified PvP frequency, controlled win rate, or complete combat formula was found. These are candidates with strategic deployment priority, not measured results. Reign levels, active troop counts, equipment and opponent change the outcome.

marches.evidence: 3-star Sheepstealer's Wild Hunt targets healing enemies; Malachite's Recovery and Forest's Instinct 3 support troop survival, and its Vanguard boosts left-flank Fire damage; 6-star Shimmer supplies available Recovery and Loyal Shield 3. Full positive Cavalry affinity.

marches.role: tactical/fire burst plus Recovery and sabotage
marches.evidence: Dawnseeker's Tactical Inferno 5 prioritizes Tactical damage on left Syrax and Fire damage on right 6-star Jagadrix; Unbroken Devotion 5 supports both flanks' Recovery Received, while Radiant Wings heals adjacent allies. Syrax's 1-star Command can grant Fire damage and First-Strike; Jagadrix has Whispering Sabotage 4. Full positive Spearmen affinity. Syrax's 6-star Recovery is locked.

6-star Zivern's Silent Shade increases target Tactical Damage Received, supporting Solstryker's even-round Tactical hits; its Vanguard boosts left Solstryker's Instinct and Initiative. Antares adds Vulnerable and Fire damage with Blazing Onslaught 3. Full positive Archer affinity.

marches.role: taunt and opening damage suppression with mixed follow-through
marches.evidence: Vaeldra's Taunt and Dragon's Valor 2 protect the formation, Rhysarion's Ebbing Fury 3 reduces damage dealt by both teams for the first three rounds and applies round-four Recovery, and Vanguard grants a damage boost to right Bevlorin. Bevlorin's 4-star Command supplies multi-target attacks and anti-Fire suppression; its 6-star Recovery is locked. Full positive Spearmen affinity.

Thunderstrike's Battle Rush 5 and Dragon's Might 2 represent current Physical investment; Arulix counters enemy Fire, has Hypnotic Helix 3, and its Vanguard reduces right-flank Thunderstrike's Damage Received. Shadowsong's Ensnare 2 and Fire Command add control/damage. Full positive Cavalry affinity; no currently confirmed team Recovery.

marches.role: physical mitigation, Weakened and late-round pressure
marches.evidence: 4-star Shadowrend's Panic and Midnight Aura 1 supply longer-fight pressure; Nyrena's Battle Dread 2 and Undermine suppress enemy output and its Vanguard mitigates damage to right Arrax; 4-star Arrax's Weakened and Stone Bulwark 1 help attrition. Full positive Shieldbearer affinity; no guaranteed team Recovery.

marches.role: taunt, Fire burst and Physical finishing
marches.evidence: Vhagar's 1-star Taunt chance doubles against Burning targets; Daemoros's Shadowflame can apply Burn and Instill Fear 3 is unlocked. Tashix delivers Fire damage and its Vanguard increases right Daemoros's Physical damage. Full positive Archer affinity. Vhagar's higher-star defensive habits are locked; manage focused fire.

Moondancer's 1-star Crescent Blade grants its effect to a Sentinel; left Vesper and Vanguard Velar both have Sentinel Tactical Commands, and Velar can grant Advantage. Velar's Vanguard boosts left Vesper's Instinct/Initiative; Moondancer can gain Rising Tide when the selected Sentinel deals Tactical damage or applies Recovery (subject to its once-per-round cap). Full positive Shieldbearer affinity. The choice of Crescent Blade recipient needs in-game verification.

marches.role: Physical finish, Protect and multi-target Fire
marches.evidence: Vermithor's Protect and Noble Sacrifice 1 protect the low-star flanks; its Vanguard reduces right Caraxes's Damage Received. Venator has repeat Physical strikes while Caraxes supplies multi-target Fire on rounds 3, 6 and 9. Full positive Spearmen affinity. The flanks' higher-star bonuses remain locked.

Vermax's 2-star Spreading Blaze can stack Tactical damage on Kalspire or Feskar, who both deal Tactical damage. Feskar's 4-star Command suppresses enemy Physical damage and its Vanguard mitigates right Vermax's Damage Received; Kalspire adds repeat Tactical hits and Bleed. Full positive Cavalry affinity. Kalspire's 6-star Command enhancement is locked.

deployment.other_five: rotation/matchup configurations, not ten simultaneous active armies

event_swap: For September 17–23 Kingswood Hunt White Stag encounters, consider the physical-damage suppression/protection of marches 4, 6, 9 or 10; choose troop counter and reign-level strength based on the encountered opponent. No event-specific measured win rates.
validation_plan: Record combat mode, game version, roster date, equipment and reign levels
Record opponent troop type, dragons, star/habit levels and starting troop counts
Compare troop survival percentage, opposing troops removed, outcome and stalemate/round limit
Note activation of control, Recovery and star-gated effects
Do not reuse pre-September-20 battle reports as if they measured this configuration
